title: Developer Experience Metrics That Drive Real Productivity | Faros

hero.headline: Boost team health and productivity
hero.subhead: Faros blends survey feedback with workflow telemetry to deliver contextualized developer experience metrics.

sections.heading: The challenge — developers lose 20% of time to friction
sections.body: Run our surveys or bring your own; align responses to workflow telemetry (blended visibility); make the right investments (diagnose pain points, track outcomes).

stats.label: of developer time lost to workflow/infra inefficiencies (page claim)

sections.heading: Our solution
sections.body: Centralize developer survey data; blend survey responses with tool telemetry for sharper insights; prioritize the right interventions and track impact. Counters recency bias by balancing feedback with evergreen data; exposes variability across teams (no one-size-fits-all).

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. Developer Experience (surveys + telemetry) is a sub-capability already represented inside faros:developer-productivity ('DevEx Insights' section). Captured as corroboration, not a new node. Notably reinforces persona:maya / principle:empower-not-police: 'expose variability across teams instead of one-size-fits-all', balance sentiment with evergreen data — improvement, not ranking. Testimonial: Mustafa Furniturewala, SVP Engineering, Coursera.
